# Design System Tokens: [Product Name]

> **Status**: [Draft / Under Review / Approved]
> **Owned By**: design-system-director
> **Last Updated**: [Date]
> **Design System Director Sign-Off (DS-DESIGN-TOKENS)**: [Not yet reviewed]

`/saas-design-tokens` writes these nine sections in this order and replaces each
section's `[To be designed]` line as that section is approved. A section still
holding its placeholder is incomplete; a later run fills only those.

## 1. Visual Identity Statement

[To be designed] — a one-line visual rule that resolves any visual ambiguity,
plus 2–3 supporting principles, each with a design test ("when X is ambiguous,
choose Y") and the product pillar it serves.

## 2. Mood & Atmosphere

[To be designed] — for each major application state (public landing, authenticated dashboard, checkout/billing, settings, empty/error states): the emotional target, lighting/theme character (light mode, dark mode, high contrast), 3–5 aesthetic descriptors, and information density level.

## 3. Shape Language & Elevation

[To be designed] — border radii scale (none, sm, md, lg, full), elevation and shadow layers (flat, raised, overlay, modal), surface borders, container geometry, and visual hierarchy between hero cards and utility widgets.

## 4. Color System

[To be designed] — semantic color palette: primary brand, secondary, neutral/slate scales, semantic states (success, warning, destructive, info), light and dark theme token mappings, and WCAG AA/AAA contrast compliance rules.

## 5. User & Role Representation

[To be designed] — user avatar styling, workspace identity, organization badges, role indicators (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer, Guest), and empty-state illustration style guidelines.

## 6. Layout & Spatial System

[To be designed] — 4px/8px spatial scale, layout containers, responsive breakpoints (sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl), column grids, sidebar navigation geometry, and content density modes (compact, default, spacious).

## 7. Typography & Micro-interactions

[To be designed] — typographic hierarchy (font families, scale from display to caption, font weights, line-heights), focus rings, hover/active states, transition durations, easing curves, and micro-interaction principles.

## 8. Asset & Token Standards

[To be designed] — SVG iconography conventions (Lucide, Radix, custom), image formats (WebP, SVG, AVIF), CSS custom properties / Tailwind configuration mappings, asset optimization budgets, and component naming rules.

## 9. Reference Direction

[To be designed] — 3–5 design references (contemporary software products, design systems, benchmark interfaces). For each: the specific element to emulate, and what to avoid so the interface remains distinct and original.
